intro: This page covers DFW’s official Terminal garages, Express North, Remote North and South, and DFW Airport Valet, with rates copied from the official DFW parking pages on November 19, 2026 (tables labeled effective October 1, 2026). Below those are eight off-airport options: The Parking Spot’s three DFW lots, an independent Euless lot, and four Irving hotels whose own pages describe a park-and-fly package. We chose operators that publish a street address and shuttle details on their own pages; this is a sample, not every lot near the airport. Shuttle hours vary a lot here, from 24/7 to a 6 AM–11 PM window, so check before a late flight. Rates are dated snapshots, not live quotes.

officialLots.prebookRate: The official page says prebooking can save up to 50% off TollTag rates; no dated prebook rate was copied.
officialLots.hourlyOrIncrement: Credit card at exit: 0–8 min $15.00; 8–30 min $3.00; 30–60 min $5.00; 1–2 hrs $7.00; 2–4 hrs $13.00; 4–6 hrs $18.00 (TollTag rates are lower)
officialLots.name: Terminal Parking (garages at Terminals A–E)
officialLots.area: Garages directly next to each of DFW’s five terminals

hours.notes: The official DFW parking pages do not publish lot opening hours; they list late-night shuttle call numbers for Express and Remote. The Terminal page says Terminal C’s south garage section has been closed for construction since 9/14/24; central and north sections remain open.

officialLots.driveUpDailyMax: $40.00 per 6–24 hours paying by credit card at exit; $37.00 with TollTag
officialLots.rateNotes: Official rates as listed on 2026-11-19 (table labeled effective October 1, 2026). No cash accepted; major credit cards and NTTA TollTags with a card on file only. Parking is limited to 90 days.
officialLots.visitNotes: Garages A, D, and E have a digital parking guidance system. The official page says EV charging is available for Valet customers in every terminal and in select locations in Terminals A and E.

sources.label: Official DFW Terminal Parking page (rates effective October 1, 2026)

officialLots.prebookRate: The official page says prebooking can save up to 50% off TollTag rates; no dated prebook rate was copied.
officialLots.name: Express North (covered and uncovered)
officialLots.access: Free shuttle with pickup at your vehicle’s trunk to all terminals; average ride 4–5 minutes per the official page

hours.notes: The official DFW parking pages do not publish lot opening hours; they list late-night shuttle call numbers for Express and Remote. The Express page says guests must call +1-972-574-7500 between 11 p.m. and 5 a.m.

officialLots.driveUpDailyMax: Uncovered: $22.00 per 6–24 hours by credit card ($20.00 TollTag). Covered: $25.00 per 6–24 hours by credit card ($23.00 TollTag)
officialLots.rateNotes: Official rates as listed on 2026-11-19 (table labeled effective October 1, 2026). No cash accepted. Parking is limited to 90 days.
officialLots.visitNotes: Express drop-off and pick-up areas are on the lower level of each terminal.

sources.label: Official DFW Express Parking page (rates effective October 1, 2026)

officialLots.prebookRate: The official page says prebooking can save up to 50% off TollTag rates; no dated prebook rate was copied.
officialLots.name: Remote North and Remote South
officialLots.area: Just before the North and South airport entry/exits
officialLots.access: Free non-stop shuttle bus to every terminal

hours.notes: The official DFW parking pages do not publish lot opening hours; they list late-night shuttle call numbers for Express and Remote. The Remote page says guests must call +1-972-973-3838 between 12 a.m. and 5 a.m.

officialLots.driveUpDailyMax: $16.00 per 6–24 hours by credit card at exit; $14.00 with TollTag
officialLots.rateNotes: Official rates as listed on 2026-11-19 (table labeled effective October 1, 2026). The official page calls Remote its most economical on-airport option. No cash accepted. Parking is limited to 90 days.
officialLots.visitNotes: Remote drop-off and pick-up areas are on the lower level of each terminal.

sources.label: Official DFW Remote North and South Lots page (rates effective October 1, 2026)

officialLots.name: DFW Airport Valet
officialLots.area: Arrivals level (Level 3) of Terminals A, B, C, and E; Departures curb at Terminal D
officialLots.access: Hand off your car at the terminal

hours.notes: The official Valet page does not publish valet stand hours.

officialLots.rateNotes: Official rate as listed on 2026-11-19 (labeled effective October 1, 2026). Prebooked Parking discounts are not valid for valet. Cash is not accepted.
officialLots.visitNotes: Valet stands are in the 1-hour zones of the garages at A15, A20, A29, B9, B30, C7, C21, E7 (reservation drop-off only), E17, and E28, and curbside at D30 and D18. Reservations and help: +1-972-574-2407. Car wash and detail services are offered.

sources.label: Official DFW Valet page (rate effective October 1, 2026)

listings.name: The Parking Spot North
listings.area: Off TX-114 (John Carpenter Fwy) north of the airport; 2.8 miles to the airport per the operator

hours.notes: The operator’s DFW page does not publish lot hours. It says its shuttle services are 24/7.

listings.shuttle: Shuttle picks you up at your vehicle. The operator says its shuttle services are 24/7.
listings.visitNotes: Entrance is on Plaza Drive, around the corner from the Holiday Inn Express & Suites Irving DFW Airport.
listings.feeNotes: The operator’s page says DFW rates start at $9/day for Basic Parking at DFW South (as listed on 2026-11-19); other prices depend on your dates in the reservation tool.

sources.label: The Parking Spot DFW locations page

listings.name: The Parking Spot South
listings.area: Just south of TX-183 (Airport Fwy); 2.9 miles to the airport per the operator

hours.notes: The operator’s DFW page does not publish lot hours. It says its shuttle services are 24/7.

listings.shuttle: Standard parkers are picked up at their vehicle. Basic parkers walk to the Basic Shuttle Pickup Area and are returned there. The operator says its shuttle services are 24/7.
listings.visitNotes: The operator says this lot suits drivers coming from Fort Worth, Arlington, and the mid-cities. Basic Parking is pay-now and non-refundable per the operator’s FAQ.
listings.feeNotes: The operator’s page says DFW rates start at $9/day for Basic Parking at DFW South (as listed on 2026-11-19); other prices depend on your dates in the reservation tool.

sources.label: The Parking Spot DFW locations page

listings.name: The Parking Spot Premium
listings.area: Off TX-114 (John Carpenter Fwy) at the Freeport Pkwy exit; 3.5 miles to the airport per the operator
listings.address: 5100 W. John Carpenter Fwy., Irving, TX 75063

hours.notes: The operator’s DFW page does not publish lot hours. It says its shuttle services are 24/7.

listings.shuttle: Shuttle picks you up at your vehicle; the operator says Premium guests are dropped off first and picked up closest to the terminals. Shuttle services are 24/7 per the operator.
listings.visitNotes: Entrance is on W John Carpenter Freeway, just west of the Best Western Plus DFW Airport Suites. Extra-wide spaces suit large vehicles.
listings.feeNotes: The operator’s page does not publish a dated Premium rate; prices depend on your dates in the reservation tool.

sources.label: The Parking Spot DFW locations page

listings.name: DFW Airport Parking by Ausby
listings.area: Euless, about 4 miles from DFW per the operator
listings.address: 977 Del Paso St, 2nd Level, Euless, TX 76040

hours.notes: The operator’s page says the facility is open 24/7, 365 days a year.

listings.shuttle: Optional complimentary shuttle run by an independent third-party operator to all DFW terminals (A–E). It must be booked in advance (call at least 30 minutes before pickup). After-hours service from 9:31 PM to 9:59 AM costs an additional fee, per the operator.
listings.visitNotes: The operator calls itself a parking-only company; shuttle concerns go to the shuttle provider. The same site also lists 1001 W Euless Blvd, 2nd Level, Euless, TX 76040 as a contact address, so confirm the entrance when you book.
listings.feeNotes: No dated rate was copied; the booking tool quotes by date.

sources.label: DFW Airport Parking by Ausby official site

listings.name: Courtyard by Marriott Dallas DFW Airport North/Irving
listings.area: Irving, north of the airport; 2.5 miles from DFW per the hotel page

hours.notes: The hotel page does not publish parking-lot hours for park-and-fly guests.

listings.shuttle: Free shuttle to and from DFW on request; call +1 972-929-4004 with your terminal and gate after you collect bags. Shuttle hours are 4:30 AM–11:00 PM per the hotel page.
listings.visitNotes: The hotel page says to check its park-and-fly packages and lists long-term parking.
listings.feeNotes: Park & Fly as listed on 2026-11-19: $10 per day for the first 7 days, and $5 per day for days of 7 or more.

sources.label: Courtyard Dallas DFW Airport North/Irving official hotel page

listings.name: Residence Inn by Marriott Dallas DFW Airport North/Irving
listings.area: Freeport Business Park, Irving; 3.5 miles from DFW per the hotel page

hours.notes: The hotel page does not publish parking-lot hours for park-and-fly guests.

listings.shuttle: Complimentary DFW airport shuttle on request (+1 972-871-1331). The hotel page does not publish shuttle hours.
listings.visitNotes: The hotel page lists long-term parking and says to contact Sales for RV and bus parking.
listings.feeNotes: Park and Fly as listed on 2026-11-19: $35/week. The same page lists self-parking at $12 per day (effective October 24, 2022).

sources.label: Residence Inn Dallas DFW Airport North/Irving official hotel page

listings.name: Candlewood Suites DFW Airport North – Irving
listings.area: Irving, north of the airport; about 2.3 miles from DFW per the hotel page

hours.notes: The hotel page does not publish parking-lot hours for park-and-fly guests.

listings.shuttle: Complimentary DFW shuttle 4:00 AM–12:00 AM daily per the hotel page. At the airport, head downstairs to ground transportation, look for the purple pillar, and call 469-472-9400.
listings.visitNotes: Parking is for registered guests; leaving your car while you fly requires the park-and-fly package.
listings.feeNotes: The hotel page says Park, Stay and Go packages are available at an additional cost; no rate is published.

sources.label: Candlewood Suites DFW Airport North – Irving official hotel page (IHG)

listings.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Dallas Ft. Worth Airport South
listings.area: Off TX-183 at the south entrance of DFW; about 1 mile from DFW per the hotel page

hours.notes: The hotel page does not publish parking-lot hours for park-and-fly guests.

listings.shuttle: Complimentary DFW shuttle 6:00 AM–11:00 PM daily per the hotel page; call the hotel for pickup information.
listings.visitNotes: The hotel page says no extended parking is available unless the park-and-fly package is purchased.
listings.feeNotes: The hotel page says to ask about Park and Stay rates; no rate is published.
